suite: C standard matrix for c+ LEGACY C mode
description: Compile and run deterministic C89 fixtures under seven -std values, comparing c+ against /usr/bin/clang and an optional Homebrew clang, and proving --emit-c preserves source bytes apart from the leading #line directive.

fixtures.name: arithmetic
fixtures.feature: integer arithmetic, promotions, shifts, unsigned wrap

fixtures.name: control_flow
fixtures.feature: for/while loops, continue, switch with default

fixtures.name: structs_arrays
fixtures.feature: struct assignment, nested aggregates, arrays, sizeof

fixtures.name: exit_status
fixtures.feature: non-zero process exit code with stdout flush

fixtures.name: std_version
fixtures.scope_reason: The numeric __STDC_VERSION__ for c2x differs between Apple clang 16 and Homebrew clang; this probe is compared only against /usr/bin/clang, the backend c+ uses by default.
